weapons.name: Siren
weapons.description: DEV boss · 15,000 base HP. Q toggles melee/ranged mode. LMB: Claw Swipe / Hellfire. 1–4: Rending Claw, Grave Slam, Shadow Rush, Last Laugh / Damnation, Eruption, Black Rain, Marked. One Siren per match.

weapons.name: Emperor Style
weapons.description: DEV · LMB: one punch per activation; chain left then right (3 stamina each). Q: electric wind hook fist launches and juggles. E: chainable wavedash. Shift: stamina-based dodge roll. Mishima Chips evolve your style.

weapons.name: Ansatsuken
weapons.description: DEV · LMB: one hit per activation; chain right punch, left punch, high kick (4 stamina each). RMB: no-cooldown parry. 1: burning Hadoken. E: Tatsumaki Senpukyaku. 2: Shoryuken. Shift: Demon Step, a longer afterimage dash with a brief invulnerable window. Exclusive arcade Chips evolve your moves.

weapons.name: L33T H4x
weapons.description: DEV · Binary bolts pause when they detect a visible enemy, then launch at that captured position. E: Root Command. Unlocks L44T Chips and greatly improves legendary / mythic odds.

weapons.name: Pistol
weapons.description: Precise shots. 7-round magazine. Hold Q: aim down sights. E: Frag Grenade, a bouncing 60-damage blast after its fuse.

weapons.name: Rifle
weapons.description: Sniper: 58 damage, 3 rounds, 1.15 s between shots, 2.6 s reload. Instant shots; travel-dependent chips use straight 150 m/s projectiles. Hold Q: 3× scope. E: Orbital Mark, a tag dart that calls an 85-damage strike 1 s later.

weapons.name: Machine Gun
weapons.description: Rapid automatic fire, 48-round magazine, 2.4 s reload. Hold Q: aim down sights. E: Underbarrel Rocket, a 55-damage blast that breaks cover.

weapons.name: Fire
weapons.description: 24-damage firebolts, 1.5 m blast and 4 burn DPS for 2 s. Q: Flame Lance. E: Meteor Strike.

weapons.name: Water
weapons.description: 20-damage fast water globes Soak (slow) on a direct hit. Q: Tidal Wave. E: Geyser Wall.

weapons.name: Lightning
weapons.description: 15-damage rapid bolts chain 6 damage to the nearest enemy. Q: Blink Strike. E: Ball Lightning.

weapons.name: Darkness
weapons.description: 34-damage heavy orbs restore 20% of direct damage. Q: Shadow Shackles. E: Black Hole.

weapons.name: One-Handed Sword
weapons.description: Committed, weight-based attacks with hitstun. Three flowing cuts: cross cut, backhand, overhead. E: rising slash launches enemies for a brief aerial juggle (38 stamina).

weapons.name: Daggers
weapons.description: 10-stamina alternating cuts and low lunges. Hitstun allows a two-hit follow-up, then an escape window. E: spinning dagger throw with gravity and limited range (30 stamina).

weapons.name: Shield
weapons.description: Committed, weight-based attacks with hitstun. Shield slam knocks enemies back and down with hitstun. E: throw the shield to knock down one enemy; it returns after impact (45 stamina).

weapons.name: Greatsword
weapons.description: Committed, weight-based attacks with hitstun. Low sweeping cuts with pivoting footwork and a rising follow-through. E: Wolf Knight somersault ragdolls direct hits, then creates an impact shockwave on landing (55 stamina; grounded start).

weapons.name: Cyber Lord
weapons.description: DEV hardlight brawler. Q Data Dash; E Firewall; 1 Packet Burst; 2 Siphon Link; 3 System Crash; 4 Kernel Panic.

weapons.name: Bow
weapons.description: Tap or hold to draw. Q: Volley. E: Rain of Arrows.

weapons.name: Bombadier
weapons.description: TNT chains and a telegraphed Grand Finale. DEV only.

weapons.name: Top Dog
weapons.description: DEV toon brawler in the Hot Dog. LMB Big Mallet; Q Boing!; E Zip; 1 Anvil; 2 Banana Peel; 3 Mustard Blaster; 4 Spring Glove; 5 Cream Pie; 6 All You Can Eat.

weapons.name: Glaive
weapons.description: Ring blade. LMB four flowing cuts (forehand, backhand, whirl, a boomerang flick); a sprint skims; Q throws it to ricochet and come back (Q or LMB while it is out bursts it); E sets it circling you.

weapons.name: Katana
weapons.description: A long curved blade, two-handed. LMB four flowing cuts (the third steps in, the fourth cleaves); a sprint rushes in with a draw cut; a cut just after a block or parry is the counter; Q Moonlit Draw (a dash, and the line splits a moment later); E Petal Storm (cuts all round, then a launch).

weapons.name: Fangs
weapons.description: DEV twin venom daggers. LMB five quick cuts, each leaving venom; a sprint dashes through foes; Q Shadow Step behind a foe; E Smoke Veil (unseen until you strike, twice as hard); 1 Fang Fan; 2 Venom Bloom; 3 Assassinate.

weapons.name: DEV Greatsword
weapons.description: DEV animation test: the Greatsword exactly (its cuts, hop, Earthsplitter, Whirlwind and techniques) on Grruzam's great sword animations.

weapons.name: DEV Katana
weapons.description: DEV animation test: the Katana exactly (its cuts, rush, counter, Moonlit Draw and Petal Storm) on Grruzam's katana animations.

chips.name: Vital Core
chips.description: +25 maximum health per installation. Additive.

chips.name: Overclock
chips.description: ×1.18 attack rate; ×0.92 damage per hit per stack. Multiplicative.

chips.name: Dodge Capacitor
chips.description: ×0.82 roll / Demon Step cooldown per stack. Rolls always keep at least 0.12 s between recoveries.

chips.name: Reinforced Frame
chips.description: ×0.88 incoming damage; ×0.94 movement speed per stack.

chips.name: Stabilizer
chips.description: ×0.72 received attack knockback per stack. Physics impulses are also damped.

chips.name: Ricochet
chips.description: +1 direct projectile bounce per stack (max 3). Retains 70% damage on each bounce.

chips.name: Splitter
chips.description: Primary impact produces 2 + stacks secondary shots, each 22% direct damage. Max 5; no recursive effects.

chips.name: Piercing
chips.description: Pass through 1 opponent and continue into props behind them. Cannot pierce cover; each target hit once. Single installation in 1v1.

chips.name: Ember Circuit
chips.description: FIRE ENCHANT: +3 burn DPS per stack for 2 s (6 damage). Flaming shots / blade. Direct hits refresh, never delay ticks. Strongest per source; stacks with poison.

chips.name: Venom Circuit
chips.description: POISON ENCHANT: +2.5 poison DPS per stack for 4 s (10 damage). Toxic shots / blade. Direct hits refresh, never delay ticks. Strongest per source; stacks with fire. No recursive procs.

chips.name: Static Discharge
chips.description: Every 4 direct opponent hits: up to 7 electrical damage per stack within 3 m, with radial falloff and line of sight. No proc recursion.

chips.name: Extended Reach
chips.description: +20% base melee reach per stack. Arc and visible sweep extend with the hit volume.

chips.name: Kinetic Driver
chips.description: ×2.4 outgoing attack impulse; ×0.93 attack rate per stack.

chips.name: Demolition Module
chips.description: +60% base structural damage per stack. Mass and launch impulse stay independent.

chips.name: Shrapnel Protocol
chips.description: Direct impact: 1.8 m blast, up to 6 damage per stack and 220 impulse, with radial falloff. Once per attack; no recursion.

chips.name: Salvage Plating
chips.description: ×0.65 environmental debris damage per stack. Applies after fragment-event cap.

chips.name: Parallel Shot
chips.description: +1 primary projectile per stack (max +3), in a 7° fan. Each projectile deals 75% damage while installed. One ammo or normal mana cost per volley.

chips.name: Echo Strike
chips.description: +1 follow-up melee sweep per stack (max 2), each at 45% damage and impulse. +5 stamina per sweep; one hit per target per sweep. Extends recovery.

chips.name: Magazine Bank
chips.description: +25% base magazine capacity per stack (rounded up). Applies to every gun, including Machine Gun. Reload fills the expanded magazine.

chips.name: Mana Reservoir
chips.description: +25 maximum mana per stack. Spells use mana; regeneration stays 12 mana/s.

chips.name: Stamina Cell
chips.description: +25 maximum stamina per stack. Melee attacks and defenses use stamina; regenerates 24/s after 0.45 s without spending it.

chips.name: Velocity Coil
chips.description: ×1.25 projectile launch speed per stack (max 4). Flatter flight and farther travel before landing; gravity is unchanged. Split fragments inherit speed and fall, but cannot home.

chips.name: Tracking Circuit
chips.description: +35°/s homing turn rate per stack (max 105°/s). Direct projectiles acquire a visible opponent within 16 m and a 50° cone. Cover still blocks shots.

chips.name: Rapid Cycle
chips.description: ×1.15 gun fire rate per stack, including burst cadence. Reload speed is unchanged. Multiplicative; combines with Overclock.

chips.name: Spell Clock
chips.description: ×1.15 spell casting rate per stack. Mana cost per cast is unchanged. Multiplicative; combines with Overclock.

chips.name: Flurry Clock
chips.description: ×1.15 melee swing rate per stack, including windup and follow-up sweeps. Stamina cost is unchanged. Multiplicative; combines with Overclock.

chips.name: Rebound Capacitor
chips.description: Block cooldown ×0.85 per copy (max 5). Base 4s; two copies = 2.89s. Minimum 1.5s. Hold does not auto-repeat.

chips.name: Phase Buffer
chips.description: +0.08s Block window per copy (max 4). Base 0.30s; maximum with this Chip 0.62s. No attacks during Block.

chips.name: Return Amplifier
chips.description: Reflected projectile damage ×1.15 and speed ×1.10 per copy (max 4). Per-projectile limits: 100 damage, 120 m/s, 3 reflections; the next Block absorbs it.

chips.name: Counter Pulse
chips.description: First successful Block per activation emits a 3m pulse: +6 damage and +360 impulse per copy (max 4), reduced by distance. Pushes loose props; cover blocks it. No elemental or recursive procs.

chips.name: Fleet Feet
chips.description: ×1.12 movement speed; ×0.94 maximum health per copy.

chips.name: Heavy Hitter
chips.description: ×1.18 damage; ×0.93 attack rate per copy.

chips.name: Quick Loader
chips.description: ×0.84 reload duration per copy. Minimum 0.2 s.

chips.name: Efficient Channels
chips.description: ×0.86 mana cost per cast, including secondary spells.

chips.name: Efficient Footwork
chips.description: ×0.86 stamina cost for attacks and secondary skills. Held shield drain is unchanged.

chips.name: Spring Soles
chips.description: ×1.18 jump launch speed per copy.

chips.name: Deep Focus
chips.description: ×1.3 mana regeneration; ×0.96 movement speed per copy.

chips.name: Second Wind
chips.description: ×1.3 stamina regeneration after the usual recovery delay.

chips.name: Broadside
chips.description: +2 projectiles, +18° volley fan; ×0.75 damage. Volleys also use the normal 75% per-projectile damage rule.

chips.name: Dense Core
chips.description: ×1.7 projectile radius; ×0.85 launch speed; ×1.7 impulse.

chips.name: Feather Rounds
chips.description: ×0.45 projectile gravity; ×0.9 damage per copy.

chips.name: Lobber
chips.description: ×2.2 projectile gravity; ×1.45 damage; ×1.5 projectile radius.

chips.name: Bank Shot
chips.description: +2 bounces. +0.2 bounce damage retention (base 0.7; two copies retain 1.1×).

chips.name: Pocket Shotgun
chips.description: +5 pellets in a 38° fan; ×0.65 damage, ×0.6 fire rate. Every pellet also uses the normal 75% volley multiplier.

chips.name: Leech Circuit
chips.description: Heal for 12% of direct health damage dealt per copy. Cannot heal past maximum HP; no splash or DoT drain.

chips.name: Executioner
chips.description: +50% direct damage per copy to opponents already below 30% health.

chips.name: Brawler
chips.description: +25% direct damage per copy while the opponent is within 5 m of you.

chips.name: Horizon Hunter
chips.description: +35% direct damage per copy when the opponent is at least 20 m away from you.

chips.name: Blind Spot
chips.description: +60% direct damage per copy when striking from behind the opponent.

chips.name: Spite Plating
chips.description: Return 15% of actual direct health damage to the attacker per copy. Cannot recursively trigger thorns.

chips.name: Repair Nanites
chips.description: Regenerate 2 HP/s per copy after 3 seconds without taking damage.

chips.name: Medic Magazine
chips.description: Heal 7 HP per completed reload per copy. ×1.12 reload duration; firing at least one round is required.

chips.name: Last Word
chips.description: +65% projectile damage per copy when the shot empties your magazine. Applies to a volley; bursts check each emitted shot.

chips.name: Field Dressing
chips.description: First successful Block per activation restores 9 HP per copy.

chips.name: Catch and Load
chips.description: First successful Block per activation restores 1 round per copy, up to magazine capacity.

chips.name: Rebound Engine
chips.description: ×1.75 melee Block retaliation impulse per copy. Harder-hitting melee attacks rebound farther.

chips.name: Bulldozer
chips.description: ×3.2 attack impulse; ×0.85 damage per copy. Throw opponents and loose cover around.

chips.name: Anchor Boots
chips.description: ×0.5 received knockback; ×0.88 movement speed; ×0.9 jump speed.

chips.name: Blast Dash
chips.description: Starting a dash creates a 3 m pulse: 14 damage and 380 impulse per copy, with distance falloff and line of sight.

chips.name: Sweeper
chips.description: ×1.3 melee sweep arc per copy (up to 360°). ×0.95 attack rate.

chips.name: Moon Boots
chips.description: Personal gravity ×0.3; jump speed ×0.8. Float through long jumps; props keep normal gravity.

chips.name: Kickback Thruster
chips.description: Firing pushes you opposite your aim by 5 m/s per copy. Aim down to launch yourself; once per volley.

chips.name: Lucky Circuit
chips.description: +15 percentage points critical chance per copy (maximum 75%). Direct hits can deal double damage.

chips.name: Vacuum Impact
chips.description: Each direct attack impact pulls nearby opponents and loose props toward it within 5 m. 1400 impulse, distance falloff and line of sight; once per attack.

chips.name: Pong Shot
chips.description: Shots become pong balls with no drop (machine gun: every third shot). A ball that hits a wall, prop or ceiling after flying 6 m rallies toward a nearby enemy you can see ahead of it, faster and harder each time (3 rallies, machine gun 1). The floor only bounces it.

stats.text: Each rally: +12% speed, up to +8 damage
No splits, homing or returning flight

chips.name: Return to Sender
chips.description: Shots fly without gravity and turn back after 24 m or 0.65 s, whichever comes first, at 240°/s. On the way back each shot can hit the same target again for ×1.4 damage. Catch an original shot to recover 1 ammo or half its base mana cost. Once per volley; return speed caps at 60 m/s, flight at 4 s / 320 m. Cover can destroy it.

chips.name: Sidewinder
chips.description: Shots weave left and right in a 6 Hz pattern, with swept collisions along their curved path.

chips.name: Dice Reactor
chips.description: Each direct hit rolls ×0.5 to ×2.5 damage on the authority. +20% critical chance. Every hit is a gamble.

chips.name: Glass Reactor
chips.description: ×2.4 damage, ×0.45 maximum health. A dangerous all-or-nothing build.

chips.name: Walking Fortress
chips.description: ×1.8 maximum health, ×0.7 incoming damage and ×0.35 knockback received; ×0.65 movement speed.

chips.name: Meteor Foundry
chips.description: ×2.5 damage, ×3 projectile gravity, ×3 projectile radius, ×0.45 cast rate, ×1.8 mana cost; +24 impact blast damage.

chips.name: Hurricane Edge
chips.description: A full 360° sweep, +2 echo sweeps, +35% base reach, ×2.8 impulse and ×0.85 damage. Echoes retain their extra stamina cost and 45% damage.

chips.name: Supernova Guard
chips.description: First successful Block per activation, including bullets and spells, explodes around YOU in a 3 m pulse: +45 base damage and +1800 impulse, reduced by distance; cover blocks it. A Block that goes nova recharges in 0.6 s, so you can chain novas under fire. +0.15 s Block window; other Blocks recharge 25% faster.

chips.name: Firework Factory
chips.description: +3 Splitter levels (five fragments at base), +12 impact blast damage, ×1.5 radius. Fragments deal 22% damage and never recursively split.

chips.name: Vampire King
chips.description: Drain 50% of direct health damage, +50 max HP; ×0.85 damage and ×0.8 resource regeneration.

chips.name: Pinball Wizard
chips.description: +8 bounces; each bounce retains full damage before other retention Chips. ×0.65 projectile gravity, ×2.4 impulse.

chips.name: Rail Driver
chips.description: ×1.8 launch speed; ×1.6 damage; ×0.65 fire rate; ×0.5 magazine capacity (rounded up).

chips.name: Torrent Engine
chips.description: +3 parallel projectiles, ×0.6 spell damage, ×1.25 mana cost. The normal 75% volley multiplier also applies.

chips.name: Duelist
chips.description: ×1.2 damage, ×1.15 attack rate, ×0.9 received damage; −10 maximum HP per copy.

chips.name: Juggernaut
chips.description: +40 max HP, ×2.5 impulse, ×0.8 received knockback; ×0.85 attack rate.

chips.name: Needle Storm
chips.description: +2 parallel shots, ×1.2 projectile speed, ×0.7 projectile radius and ×0.65 damage. Normal volley penalty also applies.

chips.name: Plague Engine
chips.description: +8 poison DPS for 4 s, refreshed on direct hits; ×0.8 direct damage.

chips.name: Inferno Coil
chips.description: +10 burn DPS for 2 s, refreshed on direct hits; ×1.5 attack impulse.

chips.name: Tesla Rhythm
chips.description: Discharge every 3 direct hits for +18 base electrical damage within 3 m per copy. Replaces the four-hit cadence.

chips.name: Wrecking Crew
chips.description: ×2.5 structural damage, ×2.4 outgoing impulse; ×0.85 attack rate.

chips.name: Scrap Knight
chips.description: ×0.6 debris damage received, +10 max HP; ×0.97 movement speed.

chips.name: Quick Guard
chips.description: ×0.7 Block cooldown; −0.04 s Block window. Timing matters (window minimum 0.1 s).

chips.name: Bulwark Timing
chips.description: +0.18 s Block window, ×1.8 melee retaliation impulse, ×1.2 Block cooldown.

chips.name: Counterweight
chips.description: ×1.4 reflected damage; ×1.4 melee retaliation impulse; ×0.9 incoming attack impulse. Reflection safety limits still apply.

chips.name: Skirmisher
chips.description: ×0.8 roll / Demon Step cooldown and ×1.08 movement speed; ×0.92 maximum HP.

chips.name: Arcane Battery
chips.description: +60 maximum mana and ×1.15 mana regeneration; ×0.93 movement speed.

chips.name: Marathon Cell
chips.description: +60 maximum stamina and ×1.15 stamina regeneration; ×0.93 movement speed.

chips.name: Drum Magazine
chips.description: +60% base magazine capacity; ×1.2 reload duration.

chips.name: Single Chamber
chips.description: ×0.15 magazine capacity (minimum 1, rounded up), ×2.0 damage, ×0.6 reload duration. Braced shot still needs 2 rounds.

chips.name: Dead Calm
chips.description: ×1.3 damage and ×1.25 launch speed; ×0.82 fire rate.

chips.name: Mana Siphon
chips.description: Drain 8% of direct health damage; ×0.9 mana cost per copy.

chips.name: Bloodblade
chips.description: Drain 25% of direct health damage; +20% base reach; ×1.15 stamina cost.

chips.name: Rubber Soul
chips.description: ×2 jump speed and ×2.8 attack impulse; ×1.5 received knockback. Everyone goes flying.

chips.name: Comet Dash
chips.description: Every roll / Demon Step turns you into a comet: you land in a 3.5 m impact blast (45 damage, scales with damage, launches enemies) and your roll / Demon Step cooldown is 40% shorter.

stats.text: Dodge ends in a 3.5 m blast

chips.name: Repulsor Crown
chips.description: ×6 attack impulse and ×3 melee Block retaliation; ×0.8 damage. Become the ring-out specialist.

chips.name: Long Roll
chips.description: +18% roll distance per stack. Does not extend invincibility.

chips.name: Quick Tuck
chips.description: +12% roll speed per stack. Covers the same distance in less time; startup and recovery stay vulnerable.

chips.name: Efficient Roll
chips.description: −15% roll stamina cost per stack. Does not reduce attack costs.

chips.name: Ghost Timing
chips.description: +0.035 s roll invincibility per stack. Invincibility is capped at 60% of the roll; startup and recovery remain exposed.

chips.name: Tumble Engine
chips.description: A racing dodge: +35% roll distance, +25% roll speed, half the roll stamina cost, +0.1 s roll invincibility and 25% shorter dodge cooldown.

chips.name: Reserve Cell
chips.description: +25 maximum stamina and +18% stamina regeneration per stack. Supports attacks and dodge rolls.

chips.name: Power Cell
chips.description: A small, steady boost to every hit.

chips.name: Gunsmith Tuning
chips.description: Tuned barrels hit harder but take longer to reload.

chips.name: Arcane Lens
chips.description: Focused spells hit harder and cost a little more mana.

chips.name: Whetstone
chips.description: Sharpened blades cut deeper but cost a little more stamina.

chips.name: Point Blank
chips.description: Gun hits on enemies within 5 m deal extra damage.

chips.name: Far Sight
chips.description: Spells that land 20 m away or farther deal extra damage.

chips.name: Adrenaline Gland
chips.description: Hit harder by running your body hot.

chips.name: Keen Edge
chips.description: Blades find weak points: some hits critically strike for double damage, and hits from behind cut deeper.

chips.name: Berserker Loop
chips.description: Greatly increases damage, but you take more damage too.

chips.name: Finisher Protocol
chips.description: Hits on enemies below 30% health deal extra damage.

chips.name: Overcharged Conduit
chips.description: Spells hit much harder at a much higher mana cost.

chips.name: Titan Edge
chips.description: A massive edge: far heavier hits, slower swings and footwork.

chips.name: Heavy Rounds
chips.description: Dense slugs hit much harder, fly slower and fill less of the magazine.

chips.name: Apex Predator
chips.description: Hugely increases damage and adds critical strikes, at the cost of health.

chips.name: Annihilator Core
chips.description: Massively increases damage. Slower attacks and a fragile frame.

chips.name: Stout Plating
chips.description: Bolted-on plating adds health and a little weight.

chips.name: Mender Cell
chips.description: Slowly recover health after 3 s without taking damage.

chips.name: Iron Will
chips.description: Shrug off a little of every hit.

chips.name: Heart Cell
chips.description: A second pump adds a share of your maximum health.

chips.name: Hardened Shell
chips.description: Take less damage, hit slightly softer.

chips.name: Vampiric Rounds
chips.description: Gun hits steal health.

chips.name: Nanite Mesh
chips.description: Nanites add health and knit wounds after 3 s without taking damage.

chips.name: Warden Core
chips.description: Front-line bulk for blade fighters.

chips.name: Arcane Ward
chips.description: A standing ward adds health and mana.

chips.name: Giant Blood
chips.description: Adds a large amount of health but slows you down.

chips.name: Blood Pact
chips.description: Every hit steals health; your frame is weaker.

chips.name: Troll Blood
chips.description: Fast regeneration after 3 s without taking damage, plus extra health.

chips.name: Colossus Heart
chips.description: Adds a huge amount of health.

chips.name: Phoenix Core
chips.description: Burning life: much more health, rapid regeneration and life steal.

chips.name: Rune Clock
chips.description: Etched timing runes bring your Q and E spells back sooner.

chips.name: Spellweave
chips.description: Extra force woven into every Q and E spell.

chips.name: Wide Sigils
chips.description: Broader circles: spell areas and blasts reach farther, a little thinner.

chips.name: Thrifty Runes
chips.description: Q and E spells cost less mana.

chips.name: Swift Orbs
chips.description: Your spell bolts fly faster and flatter.

chips.name: Spellblade
chips.description: After you cast your Q spell, your next bolts within 3 seconds (about 0.6 s of casting) hit harder.

chips.name: Mana Surge
chips.description: Damage dealt by your Q and E spells flows back as mana.

chips.name: Blood Rune
chips.description: Your Q and E spells heal you for part of the damage they deal.

chips.name: Twin Sigil
chips.description: Your E spell holds two charges. Each charge recharges a little slower. Cannot be combined with Spell Echo.

chips.name: Arcane Overflow
chips.description: Spells cast with 75% mana or more strike much harder.

chips.name: Elemental Attunement
chips.description: Become one with your element: stronger, faster, wider spells at a higher mana price.

chips.name: Spell Echo
chips.description: Your E spell echoes: a second cast follows 0.8 seconds later at half power. Cannot be combined with Twin Sigil.

chips.name: Cinder Field
chips.description: Meteor Strike leaves burning ground that lasts longer and spreads wider.

chips.name: Undertow
chips.description: Tidal Wave drags enemies toward you instead of pushing them away.

stats.text: Tidal Wave pulls instead of pushes

chips.name: Storm Recall
chips.description: Each enemy struck by Blink Strike refunds part of its cooldown.

stats.text: -2 s Blink cooldown per hit, up to 4 s

chips.name: Abyssal Core
chips.description: Your Black Hole grows larger and its collapse hits harder.

chips.name: Event Horizon
chips.description: Impacts open a 5 m black hole for 3.5 s: pulls enemies, loose cover and enemy shots inward; 10 DPS. Each eligible projectile creates a field; fields last their full duration.

chips.name: Necronomicon
chips.description: E becomes Raise the Dead: 3 zombies + 1 per extra projectile (max 14), each with 2× your maximum HP and 0.5× your movement speed. 12-damage bites scale with damage. 35 mana, 10 s cooldown, 14 s lifetime; a new summon replaces your old army.

chips.name: Chemical Spill
chips.description: Impacts leave a luminous 3 m acid pool for 4 s. Enemies inside take 12 DPS; cover corrodes. Each eligible projectile creates a pool.

chips.name: Bonfire Permit
chips.description: Impacts plant a 2.5 m bonfire for 3 s, dealing 15 DPS to enemies and cover. Each eligible projectile creates a fire.

chips.name: Deep Freeze
chips.description: Impacts create a 3.5 m frost field for 3 s. Enemies move at 45% speed inside and take 4 DPS. Each eligible projectile creates a field.

chips.name: Pocket Slow-Mo
chips.description: Impacts create a 4 m time bubble for 4 s. Enemy projectiles travel at 20% speed while inside; enemies move at 60%. Each eligible projectile creates a bubble.

chips.name: Personal Space
chips.description: Impacts create a 3.5 m repulsion field for 3 s, pushing enemies and loose cover outward continuously. Each eligible projectile creates a field.

chips.name: Friendly Fungus
chips.description: Impacts grow a 2.5 m healing garden for 4 s. Restore 6 HP/s while you stand inside. No enemy healing; each eligible projectile creates a garden.

chips.name: Storm In A Jar
chips.description: Impacts plant a 4 m electrical field for 3 s. Enemies inside take 18 DPS through visible arcs. Each eligible projectile creates a storm.

chips.name: Pop Quiz
chips.description: Impacts leave a 3 m bubble that detonates after 1 s for 25 damage and strong outward knockback. Each eligible projectile creates a bubble.

chips.name: Sticky Situation
chips.description: First impact attaches a visible bomb to its target. After 1.2 s it explodes in 3 m for 28 damage. Follows moving targets; one per eligible projectile.

chips.name: Mine Sweeper
chips.description: Each eligible projectile plants 3 proximity mines around its first impact. Arm after 0.6 s, last 6 s; each explodes for 16 damage in 2.3 m.

chips.name: Special Delivery
chips.description: Impacts leave an armed parcel. After 0.6 s, an enemy within 2.5 m detonates it for 32 damage; expires after 6 s. One per eligible projectile.

chips.name: Wait For It
chips.description: A direct impact marks a 4 m blast for 2.2 s later: 48 damage, huge knockback. Escape the warning circle. One per eligible projectile or melee attack.

chips.name: Reverse Grenade
chips.description: Impacts mark a 4 m implosion for 0.9 s later: 30 damage, pulling enemies into the blast center. One per eligible projectile.

chips.name: Pocket Portal
chips.description: First surface impact per eligible projectile blinks you toward the impact (stops at cover, max 12 m) and your arrival erupts in a 3 m shock blast for 25 damage. 1.2 s portal cooldown. Never places you inside a wall.

chips.name: Trading Places
chips.description: Direct opponent hits swap your positions, once per 4 s, and leave the opponent dazed (frozen) for 0.5 s. Both endpoints must have room for a pilot. Momentum is cleared.

chips.name: Yoink!
chips.description: Direct hits pull the opponent toward you with 1800 impulse instead of ordinary knockback.

chips.name: Air Mail
chips.description: Direct hits add an upward 8 m/s kick, scaled by the target’s knockback resistance.

chips.name: Bowling Club
chips.description: Shots grow into heavy balls at 45% launch speed and twice the radius. +4 bounces; direct hits launch enemies and loose cover with 3× impulse.

chips.name: Satellite Office
chips.description: Two satellites orbit you. Every volley also launches a homing shot from each satellite (40% damage, 150°/s tracking). Satellite shots cannot trigger Chips; Pong disables them.

chips.name: Drill Sergeant
chips.description: Shots corkscrew around their flight axis. Actual curved paths use collision sweeps; cover still blocks them.

chips.name: Going Up
chips.description: Shots accelerate upward instead of falling. +50% radius; aim low to curve over cover. Pong retains its fixed flight.

chips.name: Red Light, Green Light
chips.description: Red light: 0.25 s after firing, your shots freeze mid-air for 0.3 s. Green light: they relaunch at double speed with 50% more damage toward wherever you are aiming now. Pong keeps moving.

stats.text: Double speed and +50% damage on relaunch

chips.name: Late Bloomer
chips.description: Shots start at 25% speed, accelerating to 200% over 1 s. Their lifetime becomes 5 s. Pong keeps its fixed speed.

chips.name: Rear Guard
chips.description: Every volley also fires a 40%-damage shot directly backward. The extra shot cannot trigger Chips. Disabled by Pong.

chips.name: Four-Way Stop
chips.description: Every volley adds 3 shots at 90°, 180° and 270°, each at 35% damage. Extra shots cannot trigger Chips. Disabled by Pong.

chips.name: Double Helix
chips.description: Each volley adds two shots offset to either side, twisting in opposite directions at 45% damage. No recursive effects. Disabled by Pong.

chips.name: Heads Or Tails
chips.description: Each direct hit rolls either 2× knockback or a 6 HP heal. The authority flips the coin.

chips.name: Meteor Shower
chips.description: An impact calls down 5 warned meteors, 0.3 s apart: 26 damage each in 3 m. The first meteor tracks the pilot you hit. At most one barrage per 1.5 s; no recursive effects.

chips.name: Blade Runner
chips.description: Each primary swing launches a visible energy blade: 18 base damage, 24 m/s, 30 m range. Scales with damage; can be Blocked.

chips.name: Ground Pound
chips.description: Direct hits schedule a 3.5 m shockwave after 0.45 s: 20 damage and heavy knockback. One per sweep.

chips.name: Now You See Me
chips.description: Your swing blinks you into striking range of a visible enemy within 7 m of your aim, that swing deals 50% more damage and you are untouchable for 0.25 s while you arrive (1 s cooldown). Otherwise you step 2.5 m forward. Cover stops the blink.

chips.name: Blood Trail
chips.description: Rolling or using Demon Step drains 12 health from a visible enemy within 3 m and restores actual damage dealt. Once per dodge.

chips.name: Exit Gift
chips.description: Rolling or using Demon Step drops a proximity mine: 24 damage in 2.8 m, arms in 0.6 s, lasts 5 s.

chips.name: Hot Foot
chips.description: Each roll or Demon Step leaves a 3 m fire field for 3 s, dealing 15 DPS to enemies and cover.

chips.name: Thunder Step
chips.description: Each roll or Demon Step locks lightning onto up to 2 visible enemies within 12 m: after a 0.35 s crackle that follows them, it strikes for 30 damage in 2.5 m. With nobody near, it strikes where you started (4 m, 35 damage).

chips.name: Bounce House
chips.description: Jumping kicks off a 3 m shockwave: 10 damage and upward knockback to visible enemies. Triggers only on a grounded jump.

chips.name: Emergency Exit
chips.description: Once per round, dropping below 25% HP or taking a lethal hit restores 40 HP (a lethal hit leaves you at 1 HP first), blinks you back up to 6 m and makes you immune to damage for 1.2 s.

chips.name: Return Address
chips.description: Taking damage marks the attacker’s position for a 25-damage, 3 m explosion after 1 s. 4 s cooldown. No recursive damage triggers.

chips.name: Block Party
chips.description: First successful Block per activation drops 3 proximity mines around you. Each deals 16 damage in 2.3 m; 6 s lifetime.

chips.name: Time Out
chips.description: First successful Block per activation freezes nearby enemies solid for 1.2 s (5 m, line of sight) and leaves a 5 m time bubble for 3 s: enemy shots move at 20%, enemy pilots at 60%.

chips.name: Five Finger Discount
chips.description: Direct opponent hits steal 1 of their available rounds into your magazine. Against spells or melee, steal up to 8 of their active resource instead.

chips.name: Mana Muncher
chips.description: Direct opponent hits drain up to 10 mana or stamina and restore the amount as your mana. Guns lose up to 1 round instead, restoring 8 mana.

chips.name: Load-Bearing Surprise
chips.description: Direct cover impacts plant a 1 s demolition charge: 3 m blast, 18 player damage and strong structural damage. One per eligible projectile or melee attack.

chips.name: Toy Soldier
chips.description: First impact per eligible projectile raises a tiny 25 HP, 8-damage toy soldier for 6 s. Up to 3 toys per owner.

chips.name: Graveyard Shift
chips.description: First successful Block raises one zombie for 10 s: 2× your max HP, 0.5× your speed, 12-damage bites. Shared limit 14 zombies.

chips.name: Corpse Party
chips.description: Your summoned zombies explode when destroyed or expired: 30 damage in 3.5 m. Also raise one zombie on each successful Block activation.

chips.name: Poltergeist
chips.description: First successful Block launches nearby loose cover away from you with 900 impulse, within 6 m and line of sight.

chips.name: Do Not Press
chips.description: Once per round, dropping below 30% HP heals 30% of your max HP, makes you immune to damage for 2 s, creates a 6 m repulsion field for 4 s and restores your Block and dodge cooldowns.

chips.name: Perfect Electric
chips.description: Electric hooks recover much faster. Keep the lightning chain alive.

chips.name: Twin Thunder
chips.description: Each electric hook leaves a second lightning strike at the impact point.

chips.name: Screwdriver
chips.description: Every third airborne hit spins the enemy sideways and deals extra damage.

chips.name: Bound Breaker
chips.description: The first landing in each juggle bounces the enemy back up and deals damage.

chips.name: Magnetic Fists
chips.description: Electric hooks steer airborne enemies into your next punch while still carrying them back.

chips.name: Wall Tyrant
chips.description: Electric hooks carry enemies farther. Their first wall collision adds a damaging wall bounce.

chips.name: Iron Roll
chips.description: Take half damage during a dodge roll. You can still be interrupted and knocked back.

chips.name: Storm Footwork
chips.description: Dodge rolles leave short-lived lightning that shocks enemies crossing your path.

chips.name: Pressure String
chips.description: Your two jabs become a three-punch string with a heavier final hit.

chips.name: Counter Voltage
chips.description: Electric hooks deal greatly increased damage when they catch an enemy attacking.

chips.name: Emperor’s Rage
chips.description: Below one-third health, your punches and electric hooks deal greatly increased damage.

chips.name: Bloodline Surge
chips.description: Confirmed electric hits restore a little health and stamina.

chips.name: Shinku Hadoken
chips.description: Hold 1 to charge. Release a full charge to fire a huge, piercing five-hit Hadoken.

chips.name: Ten-Hit Rush
chips.description: Your punch–punch–high-kick chain becomes a rapid ten-hit combo with a high-kick finisher.

chips.name: Shakunetsu
chips.description: Hadokens turn crimson and inflict a much stronger burn.

chips.name: Hurricane Tatsu
chips.description: Tatsumaki spins longer, pulls nearby enemies inward and lands more kicks.

chips.name: Shin Shoryuken
chips.description: Shoryuken becomes three rising hits. The final hit launches enemies and shatters nearby cover.

chips.name: Special Cancel
chips.description: After a combo hit, interrupt your punches with Tatsumaki or Shoryuken. Special moves recover faster.

chips.name: Focus Armor
chips.description: Take greatly reduced damage while charging Hadoken. You can still be knocked back.

chips.name: Perfect Rhythm
chips.description: Landing the final combo hit restores stamina and a little health.

chips.name: Air Juggle
chips.description: Hits deal greatly increased damage to airborne enemies. Keep them off the ground.

chips.name: Afterimage Assault
chips.description: Each punch leaves a delayed echo that strikes the same location. Enemies can move away.

chips.name: Counter Hit
chips.description: Striking an enemy during their attack deals extra damage and knockback.

chips.name: Round Two
chips.description: Once per round, survive a lethal hit with a sliver of health and recover all stamina.

chips.name: L44T Brain Steal
chips.description: Replaces Block with a possession orb. Hit an enemy to control their movement and attacks for 5 seconds. Your own body stays vulnerable.

chips.name: L44T Scare Tactics
chips.description: E summons a haunted tree. Slenderman stalks the nearest enemy: he only moves when unseen, teleporting closer behind them. Staring at him fills their screen with static. If he reaches them or they stare too long, a fullscreen jumpscare ends in an instant knockout. He has 160 HP.

chips.name: L44T Nuke
chips.description: Projectile impacts mark the area with green sparks, then unleash a massive explosion that hurls nearby cover away.

chips.name: L44T Y33t
chips.description: Hits launch enemies and cover with a thousand times the knockback. Goodbye, arena.

chips.name: L44T Admin Pause
chips.description: E freezes every enemy and their projectiles for 4 seconds. You keep moving.

chips.name: L44T CTRL + Z
chips.description: Once per round, a lethal hit rewinds you to an earlier safe position and completely restores your health.

chips.name: L44T Copy / Paste
chips.description: Hits print three delayed attack orbs above the impact. They fire at the original target position like a matrix firing squad. Copies trigger impact effects but never print more copies.

chips.name: L44T Object Uprising
chips.description: Projectile impacts commandeer nearby loose cover and launch it at a visible enemy. The map works for you now.

chips.name: Hollow Crown
chips.description: +3,000 maximum health. It takes far longer to put down.

chips.name: Black Flame Hide
chips.description: Weapon hits on you burn the attacker for 30% of the damage they deal. Knockback on you is halved.

chips.name: Psychotic Break
chips.description: Every attack deals 25% more damage and you move 12% faster, but you take 15% more damage.

abilities.name: Fan the Hammer
abilities.text: Fire up to 4 remaining rounds at 0.075 s intervals, with 80% damage and 2.2x spread. Emptying the magazine reloads.

abilities.name: Frag Grenade
abilities.text: Throw a bouncing grenade that lands where you aim. 4.2 m blast after its fuse.

abilities.name: Overdrive
abilities.text: For 4 s, fire 60% faster with no spread bloom at 80% movement speed. Then vent for 0.8 s without firing.

abilities.name: Underbarrel Rocket
abilities.text: Fire a rocket that explodes on contact and breaks cover. Arms after 3 m.

abilities.name: Scope
abilities.text: Hold Q: aim down sights. Tighter shots after a short settle; slower walking.

abilities.name: Orbital Mark
abilities.text: Tag a target or point with a dart; an orbital strike tracks it and lands 1 s later.

abilities.name: Flame Lance
abilities.text: A fast piercing flame javelin: 30 damage and a strong burn.

abilities.name: Meteor Strike
abilities.text: Call a meteor on the aimed ground: 70 damage in 4.5 m, then burning ground.

abilities.name: Tidal Wave
abilities.text: Send a wave that knocks enemies back and slows them.

abilities.name: Geyser Wall
abilities.text: Three geysers erupt in sequence across the aimed point: knock-up and slow.

abilities.name: Blink Strike
abilities.text: Teleport up to 9 m, shocking enemies along the path.

abilities.name: Ball Lightning
abilities.text: A slow orb that zaps nearby enemies, then bursts.

abilities.name: Shadow Shackles
abilities.text: A dark bolt that shackles (strong slow) and heals you.

abilities.name: Black Hole
abilities.text: A vortex pulls enemies in, then collapses.

abilities.name: Flash Step
abilities.text: Dash 7 m and strike the first enemy for 26 damage. A hit refunds half the remaining cooldown.

abilities.name: Rising Dragon
abilities.text: Launch for 33.6 damage. Recast within 0.9 s for Skyfall: 22 damage and a 10-damage landing wave to others. No recast: 7 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.text: Blink 6 m. Leave a 1 s decoy; your next dagger hit within 1.5 s deals 40% more damage.

abilities.name: Kunai Mark
abilities.text: Throw for 18 damage and mark for 4 s. Recast after a visible 0.2 s shimmer to teleport behind and strike for 28. A miss reduces cooldown to 4 s.

abilities.name: Bulwark Charge
abilities.text: Charge 8 m, absorbing up to 3 frontal projectiles. Hit for 20 damage and carry 6 m; a wall collision adds 10 damage.

abilities.name: Aegis Ricochet
abilities.text: Throw for 20 damage per target, bouncing to 2 more enemies within 7 m. First hit knocks down. Blocking is unavailable until the shield returns.

abilities.name: Earthsplitter
abilities.text: Send a 10 m fissure at 25 m/s for 30 damage and 0.5 s knock-up. Its 1.6 m-wide trail slows by 30% for 2 s.

abilities.name: Whirlwind
abilities.text: Spin for 3 s while steering at 80% run speed. Seven 8.5-damage ticks in 2.6 m; the first tick staggers. Recast after 0.5 s to end early, then recover for 0.5 s.

abilities.name: Data Dash
abilities.text: Dash up to 7 m through enemies, leaving a damaging data trail.

abilities.name: Firewall
abilities.text: Raise a firewall for 4 s that absorbs enemy projectiles and damages enemies touching it.

abilities.name: Packet Burst
abilities.text: Fire eight short-range packets in a wide spread, dealing 5 base damage each.

abilities.name: Siphon Link
abilities.text: Drain a target for 2.5 s and heal for half the damage dealt; distance or blocked sight breaks the link.

abilities.name: System Crash
abilities.text: Slam after a 0.5 s windup, dealing 25 base damage and stunning enemies within 4 m.

abilities.name: Kernel Panic
abilities.text: Lunge up to 12 m with a wide sweep; connect to isolate one enemy for a cinematic combo. 20 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Blast Jump
abilities.text: Launch yourself 9 m upward and forward; the 2.5 m departure blast deals 8 damage to enemies, none to you.

abilities.name: Dead Man's Switch
abilities.text: Detonate your live charges nearest first, 0.12 seconds apart.

abilities.name: Bounce Mine
abilities.text: Throw a 15 HP mine up to 18 m. Arms after 0.5 seconds; launches enemies 8 m. Two charges, three live mines.

abilities.name: Sticky Fuse
abilities.text: Stick a 1.2-second fuse to an enemy or surface. Deals 16 damage and throws victims toward your nearest charge within 12 m. Roll to shake it off.

abilities.name: Cluster Lob
abilities.text: Heave a bundle that splits into six falling firecrackers. Each deals 8 damage; airborne victims launch twice as hard.

abilities.name: Firecracker Line
abilities.text: A fuse runs 16 m along the floor at 14 m/s. Eight 5-damage blasts shove forward; walls stop the line.

abilities.name: Grand Finale
abilities.text: Spend a full meter. Circles follow enemies, lock at 2.1 seconds, and strike at 2.6 for 40 damage. Rooted and vulnerable; death does not stop the strike.

abilities.name: Boing!
abilities.text: A spring under your feet throws you 9 m up and along your look. Landing thuds for 8 damage and pops nearby enemies up.

abilities.name: Zip
abilities.text: Wind up in place for 0.3 seconds, then zip 12 m ahead. Swats enemies on the way aside for 10 damage.

abilities.name: Anvil
abilities.text: Drop an anvil on a spot up to 22 m away. Its shadow warns for 0.9 seconds; it lands for 28 damage and flattens everyone under it.

abilities.name: Banana Peel
abilities.text: Toss a peel up to 10 m. An enemy who steps on it slips, takes 8 damage and lands on their back. Two charges, three peels out.

abilities.name: Mustard Blaster
abilities.text: Squirt mustard for 1.6 seconds: 20 damage a second in a 9 m stream, sticky slow, and slippery puddles.

abilities.name: Spring Glove
abilities.text: A boxing glove on a scissor arm punches 13 m: 18 damage, a huge knockback, and stars.

abilities.name: Cream Pie
abilities.text: Throw a cream pie: 8 damage and cream over their eyes for 2.6 seconds.

abilities.name: All You Can Eat
abilities.text: Spend a full meter. Twirl and throw a lasso of links; a caught enemy is reeled in and fed hot dogs until they burst. Rooted and hittable while feeding: 40 damage snaps the links.

abilities.name: Ricochet Throw
abilities.text: Throw the glaive along your aim: it cuts the first enemy for 26 and ricochets to the next in sight up to 3 times, then flies back to your hand, cutting on the way. Press Q or click while it is out to burst it for 30 around it.

abilities.name: Halo
abilities.text: The glaive leaves your hand and circles you for 4 seconds, cutting every enemy it passes for 10. Click to burst it.

abilities.name: Moonlit Draw
abilities.text: Sheathe and draw: dash 7.5 m along your aim, marking everyone within 1.3 m of the line. A moment later the line splits: each one marked takes 46 and staggers.

abilities.name: Petal Storm
abilities.text: A storm of six cuts all round you (2.9 m), 8 each, the last throwing them into the air. You move slowly while it lasts.

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.text: Vanish and appear behind the enemy nearest your aim within 12 m, stabbing for 24 and two venom stacks.

abilities.name: Smoke Veil
abilities.text: Smoke: enemies cannot see you for 4 s, until you attack. That attack strikes twice as hard and leaves three more venom stacks.

abilities.name: Fang Fan
abilities.text: Throw five venom knives in a fan, 9 each and a venom stack.

abilities.name: Venom Bloom
abilities.text: Every poisoned enemy within 14 m takes 6 for each venom stack on them at once, and the stacks are spent.

abilities.name: Assassinate
abilities.text: A takedown on the enemy in front: from behind, or below 40% health, it kills; otherwise a critical for 45. Both of you are held through it.

abilities.name: Gun Spin
abilities.text: Twirl the pistol: instantly reloaded, and firing faster for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Overload
abilities.text: Run hot: faster attacks and faster feet, and a shock at the end that you have to pay for.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.text: Clap your hands: a burst of thunder stuns everyone close and cuts off whatever they were doing.

abilities.name: Bipod
abilities.text: Plant the gun: tighter, faster, free fire, but you can't move until you pack up.

abilities.name: Envenom
abilities.text: Coat your blades. Your next three hits poison and slow.

abilities.name: Dragon Breath
abilities.text: Breathe a cone of fire for as long as it lasts, walking slowly, unable to do anything else.

abilities.name: Combust
abilities.text: Snap your fingers: every enemy already burning takes all of it at once, in a blast.

abilities.name: Soul Siphon
abilities.text: Hold a beam on one enemy, draining their health into yours while you can keep them.

abilities.name: Disarm
abilities.text: A quick flick of the blade. Whoever it catches can't use Q or E for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Ground Slam
abilities.text: Leap and bring the shield down: a shockwave throws everyone near the landing.

abilities.name: Reaping Sweep
abilities.text: A low circular sweep that hooks legs: everyone near you is dragged in and tripped.

abilities.name: Bolas Round
abilities.text: A slow spinning round that ties up whoever it hits, rooting them on the spot.

abilities.name: Vault Shot
abilities.text: Flip backward and loose a free arrow from the top of the flip.

abilities.name: Hydro Jet
abilities.text: A jet of water throws you opposite your aim, and shoves whoever's in the stream.

abilities.name: Iaido
abilities.text: Sheathe your blade, then press again to draw: you cross a line and cut everyone on it.

abilities.name: Challenge
abilities.text: Call out one enemy: you hit each other harder, and you run faster at them.

abilities.name: War Cry
abilities.text: Bang your shield: nearby enemies hurt anyone but you less, and you shrug off more.

abilities.name: Sunder
abilities.text: A slow overhead that cracks armour. Whoever it hits takes more damage for a while.

abilities.name: Ghillie
abilities.text: Settle down and hold still: you all but vanish, and your first shot out hits harder.

abilities.name: Flash Freeze
abilities.text: Stamp a sheet of ice under you. Enemies slide on it, and you skate.

abilities.name: Lodestone
abilities.text: Your shield pulls shots out of the air and holds them, then throws them all back.

abilities.name: Blade Drag
abilities.text: Run dragging the blade in a trail of sparks, then press again to rip it upward.

abilities.name: Breacher Round
abilities.text: Charge for a second behind a visible laser, then fire a round that punches through walls.

abilities.name: Bramble Arrow
abilities.text: An arrow that grows a hedge of thorns where it lands. Crossing it hurts and slows.

abilities.name: Tether Arrow
abilities.text: Pin an enemy to the floor with a glowing line. They can't stray far until it snaps.

abilities.name: Bubble Trap
abilities.text: A slow orb that floats an enemy in a bubble: helpless, but protected until it pops.

abilities.name: Mirror Double
abilities.text: Vanish for a second while a double runs ahead of you. One hit pops it.

abilities.name: Chain Hook
abilities.text: Throw a hooked chain and drag the first enemy it catches to you.

abilities.name: Flash Round
abilities.text: A round that bursts into blinding light. Anyone looking at it is dazzled, you included.

abilities.name: Slide Shot
abilities.text: Drop into a long slide, still shooting, and rise with a steadier aim.

abilities.name: Ammo Crate
abilities.text: Drop a crate. Anyone on your team who touches it reloads and fires faster.

abilities.name: Flak Burst
abilities.text: A shell bursts where you aim, into a cloud that shreds enemy shots passing through.

abilities.name: Flame Cloak
abilities.text: Wrap yourself in fire: shots hurt less, and anyone who hits you up close gets burned.

abilities.name: Magnetize
abilities.text: Mark two enemies and they're dragged into each other. They clash for damage and a stun.

abilities.name: Dread
abilities.text: A scream of darkness: everyone in front of you turns and stumbles away for a moment.

abilities.name: Shadow Puppet
abilities.text: Leave your shadow standing where you are. It copies every attack you make.
